en: A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a large military barracks complex with several brick buildings, arcaded wings, and a tall tower surrounding an open parade ground. On the field in the foreground, soldiers are assembled in formation while an officer stands to one side. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as the Prins Hendrik barracks in Nijmegen, associated with the colonial reserve.
